decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has won the German Bread Institute gold medal again in two successive years, so its value is largely confirmed, and as a seasonal product it costs little to keep, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.

The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning that removed three sibling breads and still has its own page, which suggests management judged its prospects favorable, though the lack of reported success leaves some uncertainty.

The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line and uses the same seasonal production, so it is cheap to keep while its prospects resolve, and its continued own-page presence signals ongoing support.
